privacy.title: Exercise of your rights (FADP)
privacy.description: In accordance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection.
privacy.intro: In accordance with the Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP), any natural person whose data is processed by Kaufmann Fiduciaire has the following rights concerning their personal data:

rights.label: Right to information
rights.text: You have the right to obtain confirmation that personal data concerning you is being processed and to receive all necessary information to exercise your rights and ensure transparency in processing.

rights.label: Right of access
rights.text: You may request access to all data concerning you held by our services.

rights.label: Right to rectification
rights.text: You have the right to request the immediate correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.

rights.label: Right to erasure
rights.text: You may request the deletion of your personal data, subject to legal retention obligations (particularly accounting and tax) to which the firm is subject.

rights.label: Right to limitation and objection
rights.text: You may object to the processing of your data or request the limitation of its use in certain cases provided for by law.

rights.label: Right to portability
rights.text: You have the right to receive your personal data in a structured and commonly used electronic format.

privacy.modalitiesIntro: To exercise any of these rights, please send your request in writing (by mail or email) with proof of identity:
privacy.mailValue: Kaufmann Fiduciaire, chemin des Semailles 42, 1212 Grand-Lancy
privacy.commitment: We are committed to responding to your request as quickly as possible, and at the latest within 30 days of its receipt.
privacy.litigation: In the event of a dispute, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).
